=== Livingston monument Peter comparison, 24 October 2026 ===

The Livingston family monument names a Peter Glasgow as Thomas and Christian's son or Janet's brother, but its two Findmypast derivatives read 12 September 1810 aged 19 and 12 September 1819 aged 48. The public BillionGraves index lists Peter in this family without resolving the original inscription. Neither death is assignable to [[Glasgow-1450]]: his current adult account has Agnes Scott and children in the 1840s, while the two monumental readings also contradict one another.<ref name="LivingstonMI2026">Findmypast, Scotland Monumental Inscriptions, Livingston, derivative transcriptions [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=PRS%2FSCOTLAND%2FMI%2FADD%2F5%2F00422894&tab=this PRS/SCOTLAND/MI/ADD/5/00422894] and [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=GBPRS%2FSCOT%2FMIS%2F511321&tab=this GBPRS/SCOT/MIS/511321] (captured 24 October 2026); compare [https://billiongraves.com/grave/Thomas-Glasgow/3399144 BillionGraves, Thomas Glasgow, marker LV 106], public index checked 24 October 2026. The three derivative accounts conflict on years, ages and some dates; they are not three independent witnesses to a precise vital fact.</ref>

Keep the 1790 record-defined child, this profile's later adult household, and the memorial Peter as distinct identity propositions pending the original stone and independent later-life evidence.
